outcome: One warm renderer is retained only while its authorized document and floor remain open. It is inert, hidden, non-rendering and has no continuing walk timer in 2D. Hidden edits defer scene reconstruction until reactivation; the current canonical revision replaces the scene before paint. Closing or replacing document/floor/scope releases all tracked resources. Both lost contexts and failed initial context creation can recover on explicit re-entry.

leadReviewCorrections.finding: A failed initial WebGL construction left runtime null and needed an explicit re-entry retry after retention replaced unmount/recreate.
leadReviewCorrections.fix: Retry only on inactive-to-active transition if context lost or runtime missing. Test injects initial graphics unavailability and proves no automatic retry loop, successful explicit re-entry and cleanup.

leadReviewCorrections.finding: A passive scene replacement effect could expose a retained old-revision canvas before paint.
leadReviewCorrections.fix: Construct/swap/dispose scenes in useLayoutEffect. Browser assertion checks that the old canvas is detached at the first visible animation frame after hidden revision correction; updated window collision behavior also passes.
